summary.text: Shannon Grove was born and raised in Kern County, served in the U.S. Army, and founded a staffing company, Continental Labor and Staffing Resources.

paragraphs.text: She represented the 34th Assembly District from 2010 to 2016, was elected to the 16th Senate District in November 2018, and in November 2022 was elected to the newly drawn 12th Senate District, which includes Fresno, Tulare and Kern counties.
In January 2019 she was elected Leader of the Senate Republican Caucus and served in that role for two years; she resides in Bakersfield.
